assignments.reason: The phrase 'אחר הפדיון' (after the pidyon) is a temporal expression of the pidyon domain itself — it names the state in which the redemption has been performed. Its essential nature is pidyon. Package 1 already contains פדיון as its dominant node; this cause-node is the same concept viewed as a completed act.

This node ('when one performs pidyon and sweetens the judgment') explicitly names both פדיון and המתקת הדין — the two core concepts of Package 1. Its essential nature is the act of redemption-sweetening, which IS Package 1's identity.

This node ('sweetening and pidyon') is a direct composite naming of the two anchors of Package 1 — המתקה and פדיון. Its essential nature is identical to the package's core identity. Appears as the cause node in edges 3371 and the unnumbered edge.
This node ('pidyon and the sweetening') is the same composite concept as 'המתקה והפדיון' with reversed word order. Its essential nature is pidyon/hamtaka — Package 1's core domain.

The annulment of the decree ('נתבטל הגזרה') is the successful realization of the sweetening. While גזרה (the decree itself) belongs to Package 3 (evil/din), the annulment of the decree IS what pidyon achieves — it is the sweetening having taken effect. Its essential nature is the positive dissolution of harsh judgment, which belongs to the domain of redemption (Package 1, good), not to the domain of constriction (Package 3, evil).
